name: @withinfocus/tba-mcp-server
description: FIRST Robotics Competition data from The Blue Alliance API: teams, events, matches, rankings, OPRs, awards, districts and media, with 89 read-only tools. Also serves four scouting skills over MCP for pre-scouting an event, briefing a match, building a pick list and checking your own scouting data.

TBA_API_KEY.description: The Blue Alliance Read API key (create one at https://www.thebluealliance.com/account)

TBA_MCP_SKILLS.description: Set to off, false or 0 to stop serving the scouting skills

tools.name: get_team
tools.description: Retrieve the full profile of a single FIRST Robotics Competition (FRC) team identified by team key (e.g., 'frc86').

tools.name: get_team_events
tools.description: List every FRC event a team registered for in a given season year.

tools.name: get_team_awards
tools.description: Retrieve every award won by a team during a single FRC season year.

tools.name: get_team_matches
tools.description: List every qualification, playoff, and finals match a team played during a given FRC season year, across all events.

tools.name: get_events
tools.description: List every FRC event scheduled or completed for a given season year, worldwide.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Retrieve the full record for a single FRC event by event key (e.g., '2023casj' for the 2023 Silicon Valley Regional).

tools.name: get_event_teams
tools.description: List every FRC team registered to compete at a specific event, with full team profiles (number, nickname, name, location, website, motto, rookie year).

tools.name: get_event_rankings
tools.description: Retrieve the live or final qualification rankings for an FRC event.

tools.name: get_event_matches
tools.description: Fetch every match played at a specific FRC event, including qualification, playoff, and finals.

tools.name: get_event_alliances
tools.description: Retrieve playoff alliance selections for an FRC event.

tools.name: get_event_insights
tools.description: Retrieve aggregated game-specific statistics computed by The Blue Alliance for an event, separated into qualification and playoff phases.

tools.name: get_event_district_points
tools.description: Retrieve district championship qualifying points awarded at an event for each participating team.

tools.name: get_team_years_participated
tools.description: Retrieve every season year in which a team has competed in FRC, sorted ascending.

tools.name: get_team_districts
tools.description: List the FRC district affiliations a team has held across its history.

tools.name: get_team_robots
tools.description: List the named robots a team has built and registered each year (e.g., 'Stronghold' for 2016, 'Citrus Circuits Quokka' patterns).

tools.name: get_team_media
tools.description: Retrieve media (photos, videos, presentations, essays) submitted for a team in a given FRC season year.

tools.name: get_team_event_matches
tools.description: Fetch every match a team played at a single specific event in one call.

tools.name: get_teams
tools.description: List all FRC teams ever registered, paginated in groups of 500.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Retrieve TBA API status: current FRC season, max season available, datafeed health flag, list of currently down event keys, max team page index, and minimum/latest mobile app versions for iOS and Android.

tools.name: get_match
tools.description: Retrieve the full record for a single match by match key (e.g., '2023casj_qm1').

tools.name: get_event_oprs
tools.description: Retrieve OPR (Offensive Power Rating), DPR (Defensive Power Rating), and CCWM (Calculated Contribution to Winning Margin) for every team at an event, returned as three team_key→number maps.

tools.name: get_event_awards
tools.description: List every award given out at a specific FRC event.

tools.name: get_team_awards_all
tools.description: Retrieve every award won by a team across its entire FRC competition history.

tools.name: get_team_events_all
tools.description: List every FRC event a team has competed at across all years it has participated.

tools.name: get_team_event_status
tools.description: Retrieve a team's competitive status and standings at a specific event.

tools.name: get_districts
tools.description: List every active FRC district for a given season year (FIRST in Michigan 'fim', New England 'ne', Chesapeake 'chs', Pacific Northwest 'pnw', FIRST In Texas 'fit', Indiana 'in', Ontario 'ont', Israel 'isr', etc.).

tools.name: get_district_rankings
tools.description: Retrieve season-end district rankings for all teams in an FRC district.

tools.name: get_teams_simple
tools.description: Paginated listing of every registered FRC team with reduced fields (key, team_number, nickname, name, city, state_prov, country).

tools.name: get_teams_keys
tools.description: Paginated listing of every registered FRC team key only (strings like 'frc86').

tools.name: get_teams_by_year
tools.description: List every FRC team that competed in a given season year, paginated in groups of 500.

tools.name: get_teams_by_year_simple
tools.description: Paginated list of FRC teams that competed in a given year with reduced team fields (key, team_number, nickname, name, location).

tools.name: get_teams_by_year_keys
tools.description: Paginated list of team keys that competed in a given FRC season year.

tools.name: get_team_simple
tools.description: Retrieve a reduced FRC team profile (key, team_number, nickname, name, city, state_prov, country).

tools.name: get_event_simple
tools.description: Retrieve a reduced FRC event profile (key, name, event_code, type, location, dates, year).

tools.name: get_events_simple
tools.description: List every FRC event for a season year with reduced event fields.

tools.name: get_events_keys
tools.description: List every FRC event key for a season year (strings like '2024casj', '2024nyro', '2024micmp4').

tools.name: get_match_simple
tools.description: Retrieve a single match with reduced fields (alliances, scores, winning alliance, timing).

tools.name: get_team_events_simple
tools.description: List a team's FRC events in a season year with reduced event fields.

tools.name: get_team_events_keys
tools.description: List the event keys a team registered for in a given FRC season year.

tools.name: get_team_event_awards
tools.description: Retrieve every award won by a specific team at a specific event.

tools.name: get_team_matches_simple
tools.description: List every match a team played in a season year with reduced match fields (no game-specific score breakdown or videos).

tools.name: get_team_matches_keys
tools.description: List every match key a team played in a given FRC season year.

tools.name: get_team_social_media
tools.description: Retrieve a team's official social media handles registered with The Blue Alliance (Twitter/X, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube channel, GitHub, team website link, etc.).

tools.name: get_team_media_by_tag
tools.description: Retrieve a team's media filtered by a specific TBA tag (e.g., 'chairmans_video', 'chairmans_essay', 'chairmans_presentation', 'imagery') across all years.

tools.name: get_team_media_by_tag_year
tools.description: Retrieve a team's media filtered by both tag and season year.

tools.name: get_event_teams_simple
tools.description: List teams competing at an event with reduced team fields (key, team_number, nickname, name, location).

tools.name: get_event_teams_keys
tools.description: List team keys competing at an event (strings like 'frc86').

tools.name: get_event_matches_simple
tools.description: List matches at an event with reduced match fields (no game-specific score breakdown or videos).

tools.name: get_event_matches_keys
tools.description: List match keys at an event (strings like '2023casj_qm1', '2023casj_sf1m1').

tools.name: get_event_predictions
tools.description: Retrieve TBA-generated match score predictions and end-of-event ranking predictions for an event when computed.

tools.name: get_match_zebra
tools.description: Retrieve Zebra MotionWorks robot-tracking telemetry for a match: per-timestep XY field positions for every robot on red and blue alliances, plus the timestamp series.

tools.name: get_team_history
tools.description: Retrieve a team's full FRC competition history aggregated into a single response: every event, every match, every award, and every robot.

tools.name: get_team_event_statuses
tools.description: Retrieve a team's per-event status for every event the team attended in a given year, returned as an object keyed by event_key.

tools.name: get_team_event_matches_simple
tools.description: Lighter variant of get_team_event_matches: every match a team played at a single event with reduced match fields (no game-specific score breakdown or videos).

tools.name: get_team_event_matches_keys
tools.description: Lightest variant returning only match keys for a team at a specific event.

tools.name: get_district_events
tools.description: List every FRC event in a district (e.g., all 2024 FIRST in Michigan district qualifying events plus the district championship).

tools.name: get_district_events_simple
tools.description: List events in an FRC district with reduced event fields.

tools.name: get_district_events_keys
tools.description: List event keys in an FRC district.

tools.name: get_district_teams
tools.description: List every team affiliated with an FRC district in a given year.

tools.name: get_district_teams_simple
tools.description: List teams in an FRC district with reduced team fields.

tools.name: get_district_teams_keys
tools.description: List team keys in an FRC district.

tools.name: get_district_history
tools.description: List every season of an FRC district by abbreviation, following renames (e.g., 'mar' to 'fma').

tools.name: get_district_dcmp_history
tools.description: List every district championship event a district has held, across all seasons, each paired with the awards given there.

tools.name: get_district_insights
tools.description: Retrieve all-time statistics for a district by abbreviation.

tools.name: get_district_advancement
tools.description: Retrieve which teams in a district season advanced to the district championship and to the FIRST Championship.

tools.name: get_district_awards
tools.description: List every award given at every event in a district season, including the district championship.

tools.name: get_event_advancement_points
tools.description: Retrieve the advancement points each team earned at an event, using whichever system the event belongs to: district points for district events, or FIRST Championship regional pool points for 2025+ regionals.

tools.name: get_event_coprs
tools.description: Retrieve component OPRs (COPRs) for every team at an event: per-team estimates of how much a team adds to each individual scoring component, not just total score.

tools.name: get_event_practice_matches
tools.description: Fetch the practice matches played at an FRC event, which get_event_matches does not include.

tools.name: get_event_practice_matches_simple
tools.description: List practice matches at an event with reduced match fields (no game-specific score breakdown or videos).

tools.name: get_event_practice_matches_keys
tools.description: List practice match keys at an event (strings like '2025casj_pm1').

tools.name: get_event_media
tools.description: Retrieve media attached to the event itself rather than to its teams, such as event YouTube videos and photo galleries.

tools.name: get_event_nexus_info
tools.description: Retrieve live match-queuing info and the pit map for an event from Nexus (frc.nexus), as cached by TBA.

tools.name: get_event_playoff_advancement
tools.description: Retrieve how alliances advanced through each playoff level at an event.

tools.name: get_event_regional_champs_pool_points
tools.description: Retrieve FIRST Championship regional pool points earned at a 2025+ regional event.

tools.name: get_event_team_media
tools.description: Retrieve that season's media for every team at an event in one call: robot photos (imgur), reveal videos (YouTube), CAD (Onshape, GrabCAD), Chief Delphi threads, and avatars.

tools.name: get_event_teams_statuses
tools.description: Retrieve every team's status at an event in one call, returned as an object keyed by team key.

tools.name: get_insights_leaderboards
tools.description: Retrieve TBA leaderboard insights for a season, or all-time with year 0.

tools.name: get_insights_notables
tools.description: Retrieve TBA notables insights for a season, or all-time with year 0: lists of teams with notable achievements such as Hall of Fame membership, Championship wins, division wins, and Impact Award finals.

tools.name: get_insights
tools.description: Retrieve every global (non-district) TBA insight for a season, or all-time with year 0, across all categories: leaderboard, streak, timeseries, game_stats, and clubs.

tools.name: get_insights_by_category
tools.description: Retrieve global TBA insights for a season (or all-time with year 0) in one category.

tools.name: get_insights_for_district
tools.description: Retrieve TBA insights scoped to one district for a season, or all-time with year 0, across all categories (leaderboard, streak, timeseries, game_stats, clubs).

tools.name: get_insights_for_district_by_category
tools.description: Retrieve TBA insights scoped to one district for a season (or all-time with year 0) in a single category: leaderboard, streak, timeseries, game_stats, or clubs.

tools.name: get_regional_advancement
tools.description: Retrieve FIRST Championship advancement for regional (non-district) teams in a season, keyed by team key.

tools.name: get_regional_rankings
tools.description: Retrieve the season-long FIRST Championship regional pool rankings (2025 and later).

tools.name: get_search_index
tools.description: Find FRC teams and events by name when you do not know their keys (e.g., 'Cheesy Poofs' for frc254, 'Silicon Valley' for 2025casj).

tools.name: get_sponsors
tools.description: Retrieve The Blue Alliance's current platinum sponsors in display order (0 to 3 entries), with name, link URL, logo style, and light and dark logo URLs.

tools.name: get_team_events_all_simple
tools.description: List every FRC event a team has competed at across all years with reduced event fields (key, name, event code, type, location, dates, year).

tools.name: get_team_events_all_keys
tools.description: List the key of every FRC event a team has competed at across all years.

skills.name: check-scouting-data
skills.description: Compares your own scouting data with TBA schedules and score breakdowns and lists suspect matches to re-watch.

skills.name: match-preview
skills.description: A one-screen brief on the six teams in an upcoming qualification or playoff match.

skills.name: pick-list
skills.description: Tiered first-pick and second-pick lists for alliance selection, from TBA rankings, OPRs and your scouting data.

skills.name: pre-scout-event
skills.description: A roster of every attending team's season so far, plus a short list of match videos to watch.
